messages:
Maria (CS Ops): hey team — Aurelius Labs asking to run a 48h pilot from sa-east-1 next week. They need: a temporary rate uplift, IP allowlist + region enabled. can we do this by Mon morning?
Jake (Customer Success): noted. do we have the CIDRs and an expected RPS/TPM profile?
Maria (CS Ops): CIDRs coming from customer now, they said peak is ~120 RPS (burst to 250) for 2 hours/day. duration = 48h then revert. they want egress from sa-east-1 and earliest enable on monday 08:00 BRT.
Maria (CS Ops): customer pasted CIDRs:
```
203.0.113.0/24
198.51.100.128/25
```
Maria (CS Ops): also asked for a short note to PS about on-call support and a contact for billing in case usage overshoots.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): thanks — can do a temporary rate window. propose: create a policy with token bucket bump to 3x baseline for "aurelius-prod-pilot" + prefix cache warm. we should also pin to a low-latency model variant to keep latency stable.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): sample config snippet for the ops-run (for deploy team):
```json
{"customer":"aurelius","region":"sa-east-1","temp_rate_multiplier":"3","start":"2025-11-03T08:00:00-03:00","end":"2025-11-05T08:00:00-03:00","allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25"]}
```
Sylvia (Network): quick Q — do they need peering or just allowlist + NAT egress? if peering we need 7d lead.
Maria (CS Ops): they only asked for allowlist/NAT egress. no dedicated peering for pilot.
Jake (Customer Success): I'll confirm billing contact and capture renewal note: they flagged that a failed pilot could put renewal at risk. we should attach a post-pilot health check and product walkthrough.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): capacity-wise sa-east-1 has headroom but we should add a fallback policy: if node queue > 80% auto-route to hosted fallback model (slightly cheaper variant) to avoid errors.
Jake (Customer Success): good call. can we add a 10% pre-warm of KV cache before start?
Ethan (Eng-SRE): yes — I'll schedule a cache-warm job 30m before start.
deploy-bot: change requested: temporary-rate-policy for customer=aurelius scheduled 2025-11-03T08:00. runbook: ops-runbook://aurelius-pilot-1755550000
Sylvia (Network): network rule added to staging allowlist for validation. please test from one of their IPs and confirm echo.
Maria (CS Ops): coordinating test with Aurelius — they will ping at 06:30 BRT on Monday. Jake, can you own billing follow-up?
Jake (Customer Success): yep — I'll email billing now and add the renewal-risk note to the account. copying @Ethan and @Sylvia for visibility. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS Ops): thanks all. logging this in the customer playbook and I'll update the ticket with the deploy-bot runbook link.
Jake (Customer Success): post-pilot actions: 1) run perf report, 2) capture QA prompt set for eval, 3) schedule review with AE within 3 business days.
Maria (CS Ops): if anything goes sideways ping #eng-oncall — we've put an on-call window. close out once we confirm revert at 08:00 2025-11-05. :white_check_mark:
